solution.what: Key sheet "Clave núm. 109" found in the same fonds (DLXXIII.1.28.14-23).
Contemporary pair DLXXIII.2.41.18-41 / 1.29.9-30, key frozen: 1.000 chars / 1.000 words on the held-out part (200 controls <= -0.021 / 0.111).
Three telegrams decoded: 67 words, 64 certain, 3 probable.

outcome.method_basis: The printed key sheet issued to the general is filed with the telegrams; validated on a contemporary cipher / plain-text pair of the same fonds.
outcome.fraction_read_source: 67/67 cipher words read in their sense; 64 certain, 3 probable, 0 restored, 0 unresolved.

credits.note: key sheet identified, validated on a contemporary pair, three telegrams transcribed and read, English translation

texts.label: Lampazos, 18 July 1913, to the Minister of War and Navy (DLXXIII.1.30.16-49, incomplete)
texts.summary: Laredo garrison courted by the Carrancistas; General Treviño at San Antonio in touch with revolutionaries; Téllez should stay at Laredo.

reading_review.note: Read as Spanish sentences and translated: the cipher passages of the three telegrams (67 words) read as coherent sentences with the plain text around them; three probable words only. The scorer's 55% counts the plain-text stretches as holes.
